_comment: F-16A Block 10/15 top-level design REQUIREMENTS -- what the aircraft must DO. ★ SCOPE GUARD: this file holds REQUIREMENTS ONLY, never SPEC DATA (what the aircraft IS -- reference areas, AR, taper, sweep, t/c, fuselage envelope, thrust, engine model: those stay in examples/F16A/f16a_L{1,2,3}.json). Hold that boundary: the file is fidelity-independent and will grow with constraint + mission analysis, so it becomes the most cross-cut input in the repo, and one spec value migrating in would spread everywhere. NOT per-fidelity -- requirements do not vary with fidelity level, hence one file and no _L{1,2,3} suffix. The CONSTRAINT CONDITIONS now live here too, in the .constraints block below -- each is a REQUIREMENT (what the aircraft must DO: sustain 4.5 g, cruise at M 0.87, take off in 4000 ft), never discipline/spec data. That block holds condition + field-requirement data ONLY: NO discipline-owned quantity (no CLmax, CD0, K1, K2, CDx, thrust lapse alpha, or TSFC -- those come from the injected aero/prop objects at run time). CONSUMERS: design_mach -> F16WeightsL2 + F16WeightsL3 (Raymer Eq. 10.10 M^0.25 for W_en; Eq. 15.3 M^0.341 VT; Eq. 15.17 M^0.003 flight controls) and F16GeomL1 (Raymer 7th Tbl 4.1 AR_eq, GeomL1.m:121-129) -- ★ F16GeomL1 READS design_mach FROM HERE as of Phase 4 -- f16a_L1.json .geometry.M_max was deleted as the third copy of this quantity, and F16GeomL1(json_path, req_path) now takes both paths (todo 2026-07-25 Phase 4 §P4-14, resolved); cruise.altitude_ft + cruise.mach -> F16WeightsL3 only, which BUILDS the AircraftState itself for SFC_mission = prop.get_TSFC(cruise) -- no AircraftState is injected. Revives PLAN.md's Step-0 requirements.json, which docs/PLAN.md:178 records as planned-but-never-built. Minimal first version: only what Phase-4 weights needs. Full spec: docs/weights_parameter_usage.md §2.

constraints._comment: The 9 F-16A constraint conditions (Stall last). Each object holds REQUIREMENT / CONDITION data ONLY -- the flight condition and the field-performance requirement. NO discipline-owned quantity is present: CLmax/CD0/K1/K2/CDx come from the injected aero object, thrust-lapse alpha and TSFC from the injected prop object, and takeoff/landing gear+flap drag from aero's get_Delta_CD0_TO()/get_Delta_CD0_L(). See examples/F16A/mds/f16a_requirements.md for the schema + full per-field citations.
constraints._cite: Consts! = VnV/BrandtF16A/GroundTruth/Brandt-F16-A.xls 'Consts' tab; Main! = its 'Main' tab; Ps! = its 'Ps' tab; f16a_geometry.json = VnV/BrandtF16A/GroundTruth/f16a_geometry.json .constraints block; cell-map = VnV/BrandtF16A/GroundTruth/cell-map.md.
constraints._note_beta: beta = W/W_TO at which the condition must be met -- a SPECIFIED REQUIREMENT INPUT (user directive 2026-08-04), NOT a mission-analysis output. Operational (thrust) rows = 0.89966696 [Brandt Consts!B23; f16a_geometry.json .constraints.beta_perf]. Field/stall rows (at TOGW) = 1.0.
constraints._note_power_setting: power_setting is derived from the Brandt AB% column: 0 % -> "mil", 100 % -> "AB". Takeoff always evaluates at full AB and carries no power_setting key; Landing is power-off and carries none.
